args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to all production regions) began failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification: service healthy again, error rate down to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until a fix is validated (note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is healthy again, error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification. The incident paged the on-call engineer.

Note for follow-up: v2.3.1 (and its rc) were unhealthy, so it should not be redeployed until root cause is found and a fix passes staging validation.
